title: Dichtungswerk cuts the allocation for Mechanical seal 32 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Dichtungswerk cuts the allocation for Mechanical seal 32 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM. Need: 4690 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 4456. Prepare from the data package.
